rows.speaker: عبد الله
rows.claim: Abdullah reports that Jewish men asked the Prophet about the Spirit; after receiving revelation, he answered with 17:85. Al-Tirmidhi grades the report hasan sahih.
rows.anchor: عن عبد الله، قال كنت أمشي مع النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم في حرث بالمدينة

none: The hadith describes Paradise's adornment without explaining 19:64; the shared between-heavens-and-earth wording is incidental.

rows.speaker: ابن عباس
rows.claim: Ibn Abbas reports that the Prophet asked Gabriel why he visited less often; 19:64 was then revealed. Al-Tirmidhi grades it hasan gharib.
rows.anchor: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِجِبْرِيلَ

rows.speaker: علي بن أبي طالب
rows.claim: Ali reports the Prophet's prayer supplication, including a prostration invocation that echoes 23:14's closing praise. Al-Tirmidhi grades the report hasan sahih.
rows.anchor: عن علي بن أبي طالب، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كان إذا قام إلى الصلاة قال

rows.speaker: علي بن أبي طالب
rows.claim: Ali reports another version of the Prophet's prayer supplication, again using the verse's closing praise during prostration. Al-Tirmidhi grades it hasan sahih.
rows.anchor: عن علي بن أبي طالب، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كان إذا قام إلى الصلاة قال

rows.speaker: علي بن أبي طالب
rows.claim: Ali reports that the Prophet raised his hands at prayer's start, before bowing, after rising, and when standing from two prostrations; in prostration he recited the creation praise ending in 23:14. Al-Tirmidhi grades it hasan sahih.
rows.anchor: عن علي بن أبي طالب، عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Tirmidhi says al-Shafi'i and some of his associates followed the reported hand-raising practice.
rows.anchor: والعمل على هذا عند الشافعي وبعض أصحابنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Tirmidhi reports that Ahmad did not endorse the described hand raising.
rows.anchor: قال أبو عيسى وأحمد لا يراه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some Kufan and other scholars held that the gesture belongs in voluntary prayer, not obligatory prayer.
rows.anchor: وقال بعض أهل العلم من أهل الكوفة وغيرهم يقول هذا في صلاة التطوع ولا يقوله في المكتوبة

rows.speaker: سليمان بن داود الهاشمي
rows.claim: Sulayman al-Hashimi compares this report to the well-known report of al-Zuhri from Salim from his father.
rows.anchor: سمعت سليمان بن داود الهاشمي يقول وذكر هذا الحديث فقال هذا عندنا مثل حديث الزهري عن سالم عن أبيه

none: The hadith about the reward or sin of calling others concerns guidance, not Qarun's sinking in 28:81; the wording overlap is incidental.
The report concerns a nighttime burial and funeral prayer, with no connection to Lot's people in 29:29.

words: إذ تقول للذي أنعم الله عليه
rows.speaker: عائشة
rows.claim: Aisha says that if the Prophet concealed any revelation, he would have concealed 33:37's command concerning Zayd and his wife. Al-Tirmidhi calls her report gharīb.
rows.anchor: عن عائشة، رضى الله عنها قالت لو كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كاتما شيئا من الوحي

words: ما كان محمد أبا أحد من رجالكم
rows.speaker: عائشة
rows.claim: Aisha says people objected that the Prophet married Zaynab, his adopted son's former wife; 33:40 answered that Muhammad was not the father of any man.
rows.anchor: عن عائشة، رضى الله عنها قالت لو كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كاتما شيئا من الوحي

rows.speaker: عائشة
rows.claim: Aisha glosses Zayd's blessings as Islam and emancipation; adopted Zayd, called ibn Muhammad, must be attributed to his father, while unknown fathers mean brother or client, the juster rule.
rows.anchor: عن عائشة، رضى الله عنها قالت لو كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كاتما شيئا من الوحي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Tirmidhi calls the narration gharīb and notes an alternate route through Masruq and Aisha that preserves only the shorter opening, not the full account.
rows.anchor: قَالَ أَبُو عِيسَى هَذَا حَدِيثٌ غَرِيبٌ

none: The hadith concerns Aisha's conversation after the dawn sunnah prayer and speech before Fajr, not 39:22.

rows.speaker: عبد الله بن بسر
rows.claim: A man overwhelmed by many Islamic duties asks for a practice to hold onto; the Prophet tells him to keep his tongue moist with remembrance of God. Al-Tirmidhi grades it hasan gharib.
rows.anchor: عن عبد الله بن بسر، رضى الله عنه

rows.speaker: أبو الدرداء
rows.claim: Abu al-Darda reports the Prophet ranking remembrance of God above charity and even combat as the best and most elevating deed; Tirmidhi gives no explicit grade.
rows.anchor: عن أبي الدرداء، رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ

rows.speaker: معاذ بن جبل
rows.claim: Muadh adds that nothing better saves a person from God's punishment than remembrance of God.
rows.anchor: فقال معاذ بن جبل رضى الله عنه ما شيء أنجى من عذاب الله من ذكر الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Tirmidhi notes that some narrators preserve this connected chain, while others transmit it mursal from Abdullah ibn Sa'id; he gives no explicit grade.
rows.anchor: قال أبو عيسى وقد روى بعضهم هذا الحديث عن عبد الله بن سعيد مثل هذا بهذا الإسناد وروى بعضهم عنه فأرسله

rows.speaker: ابن عمر
rows.claim: Ibn Umar reports the Prophet's conquest-of-Mecca sermon rejecting ancestral arrogance: people rank by piety, all descend from Adam, created from dust. Al-Tirmidhi calls the report gharīb.
rows.anchor: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَطَبَ النَّاسَ يَوْمَ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Tirmidhi notes Yahya ibn Ma'in and others weakened Abdullah ibn Ja'far, the route is gharīb, and reports also come from Abu Hurayra and Ibn Abbas.
rows.anchor: وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ يُضَعَّفُ ضَعَّفَهُ يَحْيَى بْنُ مَعِينٍ وَغَيْرُهُ

rows.speaker: ابن عباس
rows.claim: Ibn Abbas says the Prophet neither recited to nor saw the jinn: a group heard him praying at Nakhla, believed, and their declaration was revealed in 72:1. Al-Tirmidhi grades it hasan sahih.
rows.anchor: عن ابن عباس، رضى الله عنهما قال ما قرأ رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم على الجن ولا رآهم انطلق رسول الله

words: لما قام عبد الله يدعوه كادوا يكونون عليه لبدا
rows.speaker: ابن عباس
rows.claim: Ibn Abbas explains the jinn's crowding around as amazement at the Prophet and companions praying together and following his prostrations; al-Tirmidhi grades the report hasan sahih.
rows.anchor: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَوْلُ الْجِنِّ لِقَوْمِهِمْ

none: The report discusses a man's rings and permissible jewelry; its wording does not explain 80:18.
